fusions.name: Coiled Lunge
fusions.desc: You rush to the target and deal 14 damage, poisoning it for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a narrow cone that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it and poisons each for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Sentry Coil
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to raise a coil that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds, each strike with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Venom Spark
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
